# SM Marketing Group

> Sinead Murphy is a Fractional CMO and AI Marketing Consultant based in Dublin, Ireland, providing senior marketing leadership for ambitious Irish brands.

## Who she is

Sinead Murphy has 20+ years of marketing leadership at Director and C-suite level across retail (Liffey Valley Shopping Centre / Hines), aviation (Aer Lingus Regional / Stobart Air), and telecoms (eircom / eMobile / Meteor). She is the founder of SM Marketing Group.

Credentials: Marketing Director at Hines / Liffey Valley SC (2016-2025), Head of Marketing and Sales at Stobart Air / Aer Lingus Regional (2011-2016), Retail Marketing Lead at eircom / eMobile (2009-2011), Hines European ESG Award Winner, BREEAM Outstanding, PG Dip Innovation for Sustainability UCD Level 9, multiple AI certifications.

## What she does

- Fractional CMO: C-suite marketing leadership on a part-time basis, embedded in the business, accountable for commercial KPIs
- Brand Strategy and Repositioning: brand launches, identity development, repositioning and execution
- AI in Marketing: AI adoption audits, team upskilling programmes, AI integrated into marketing strategy
- Strategy and Planning: annual marketing strategy, market analysis, audience segmentation, channel strategy
- Digital and Content Marketing: social media strategy, content planning, email marketing strategy (strategy and direction only)
- Website and Web Presence: commercially focused websites with SEO built in

## Key results

- 20% footfall increase at Liffey Valley Shopping Centre
- 10M+ annual visitors at Liffey Valley Shopping Centre
- ABC1 customer profile increased from 62% to 71%
- Average dwell time increased from 87 to 98 minutes
- +11% above sales target on Meteor Broadband To Go campaign
- 1.4M annual passengers across Aer Lingus Regional and Stobart Air
